item_short_desc: Rothco's 95lb Micro Cord is a compact and versatile tool designed to handle countless outdoor and survival applications. Originating from parachute suspension lines, this Type I paracord measures approximately 1/16 inch in diameter and comes on a 100ft spool, making it easy to store and carry. With a tensile strength of 95lb, the durable cord is perfect for tying gear, creating traps, or even serving as a fishing line. Made in the USA, this micro cord is crafted for quality and reliability, ensuring it holds up during critical tasks.
